how: The opening flag proposal supplies a starter act without establishing continuing command over contributors.
Members call the room to make a flag and recruit help with an explicit location.
Joining the work includes asking how placement works and receiving colour, coordinate and timer instructions.
A repair proposal receives a bare commitment to join.
The explicit repair call and bare answer establish the written pair without measuring silent acceptance through placement.
The initiating proposal already calls for hands, so starting and recruitment need not be separate observable stages.
Capacity judgments limit expansion and favour maintaining existing work rather than necessarily prompting abandonment.
Relocation is proposed and announced, but the concepts do not establish a loss causing the move.
Warnings about maintainable size and a new-location announcement do not establish the proposed shortage-to-move mechanism.
Contributors propose national figures, debate additions and revise the shared flag rather than settling one immutable design.
Construction is reported through requests to stop erasing completed parts and coordinates locating the result.
Calls and contribution reports establish participation but do not identify which appeal caused a particular contributor to arrive.
A pixel grid makes the revised drawing countable and receives an explicit assessment of its use against mistaken sabotage.
A revised plan must become recognisable to defenders as well as available to builders before protective erasure stops obstructing construction.
Publishing a template does not establish settled agreement when defenders have not seen or recognised the intended revision.
This local exception requires distinguishing proposed teams from enacted thread rules and both from demonstrated command over pixel placement.
Choosing the organising venue itself becomes a dispute answered by explaining how uncoordinated makers erase one another.
A defender reports repairing through approximately ten accounts, supporting claimed spare-account use rather than verified automation.
Observer suspicions based on instant repair or recurring squares must remain distinct from an operator's account-use report.
The repair-and-accounts report does not establish that insufficient maintenance capacity caused the use of extra accounts.
Members guard overnight, repair letters and hearts, and recall last-pixel defence.
Maintenance overlaps redesign and can obstruct building rather than occurring only after a finished part is available to preserve.
Defenders identify their own friendly fire and explain that they mistook a planned revision for vandalism.
Defence preserves the intended work only when contributors recognise the current design rather than zealously restoring its superseded version.
Failure to find a public plan supports a provisional unplanned-work diagnosis that precedes explicit repair commitments.
A provisional judgment that work is unplanned is followed by repair commitments, while another branch discovers organisation outside the host thread.
Visitors propose non-aggression and contributors invoke an existing neighbour deal as an obligation.
A visitor carries a formal proposal for another room without demonstrating a standing diplomatic office.
Members oppose attacks by naming their costs and warning against damaging neighbouring art.
Mutual-defence requests receive help promises and later participants thank neighbours for cooperation.
An agreed shared heart and an outside participant's help constitute a small joint undertaking without demonstrating a permanent coalition.
A conquest call is checked by an explicit reminder linking the existing agreement.
The conquest reply invokes an earlier agreement rather than demonstrating that the attack proposal caused negotiation.
Attack refusals can be bare rather than supplying the reason described as usual by the model.
Heart-space requests include refuge and receive individual assent, showing host-like negotiation without proving completed transfers.
Individual willingness to share space does not establish enforceable host jurisdiction or collective approval.
A heart-space claimant explicitly seeks someone in charge, instantiating the authority-seeking end of this tentative element.
Refusal of an agreed design and fear of uncoordinated expansion do not alone establish an explicit dispute over who may bind placers.
The concepts do not connect the request for a representative causally to the making of a specific agreement.
Maintenance, border complaints and diplomacy coexist without establishing the proposed causal passage from upkeep to negotiation.
A request for reciprocal defence identifies needed help but does not establish manpower shortage as its cause.
The pact proposal precedes an answered help offer, but sequence alone does not establish that border talk created the helping channel.
A shared heart and its reported defence do not establish a common threat as the cause of coalition formation.
The unplaced concept invoking a missing room joke fits the candidate's existing range of carrying room lore into the canvas.
A refusal to stop expansion explicitly invokes national rivalry without establishing a prior dispute between the subreddits themselves.
Historical territorial rivalry is named in the same turn that refuses to stop encroaching.
Canvas expansion becomes a joke used to reinterpret an unrelated political protest without turning that discussion into placement organisation.
Fake political news receives date checks and verification, while the holiday licence itself is disputed.
An apparent ban is believed, tested, protected from spoilers and disowned by moderators within the same prank episode.
A prank's apparent moderator authorship must remain distinct from actual authorship when moderators explicitly deny sending it.
Moderators route proposals to one organising thread and explicitly remove repeated posts to maintain centralisation.
The removal notice explicitly identifies centralised discussion as its reason for allowing only the first post on the subject.
A general low-karma spam restriction applied to a canvas post does not establish a new rule directed specifically at canvas discussion.
Contributors celebrate the work and allocate credit between individual pixel labour and everyone's contribution.
The room shares external records and animations and identifies its figure in a timelapse.
Participants explicitly mark the end of pixel placement while claiming collective achievement.
The builder's edited turn combines a request to stop erasing the design with an explicit completion celebration.
Recording can directly answer a visitor's success question, so its occurrence after celebration does not establish celebration as the cause.
Sharing records is observed, but the coded passages do not show contest over which post-event version should be preserved.
The canvas image continues as physical beadwork and requested vector files for a proposed sticker.
Post-event continuation includes challenging claimed inspiration and teaching how to reproduce the physical object.
A vector request directly elicits derivatives, but the record does not establish a particular saved canvas record as the cause of that request.
Attack proposals include converting neighbouring flags, while one participant reports actually changing an American pixel.
Deliberate playful overwriting also targets the room's own national sign, so the repertoire cannot be limited to attacks on other rooms.
National rivalry continues in a visitor's challenge, a local denial and a territorial-history refusal.
A newcomer's instruction precedes that speaker's attack report and call, without establishing original room recruitment as the cause of every attack.
A rival's challenge and local denial demonstrate contested talk without independently establishing the attack that supposedly caused it.
Participants turn being fooled into shared stories and delay a reveal to preserve the prank beyond its initial presentation.
